title: OmniPod fault 049 INSULIN_DELIVERY_COMMAND_ERROR when temp basal is automatically set
symptom: The pod suddenly started screaming and got a 049 error. The phone was unused in my pocket at the time. The error appears to happen when the app is trying to set a temporary basal in response to a new glucose reading.
evidence_quote: My pod suddenly started screaming and i got a 049 error. The phone was unused in my pocket at the time. Looking as the logs, the error appears to happen when the app is trying to set a temporary basal in response to a new glucose reading.
